examplePinyin: Tā de qiánrèn bǎ gōngzuò ānpái de hěn qīngchu。
exampleEn: His predecessor arranged the work very clearly.
cloze: 他的＿＿把工作安排得很清楚。

en: to lack; to be short of; shortcoming; deficiency
exampleZh: 他在经验上还有些欠缺。
examplePinyin: Tā zài jīngyàn shàng hái yǒuxiē qiànquē。
exampleEn: He still has some shortcomings in experience.

exampleZh: 公司强制员工每天穿工作服。
examplePinyin: Gōngsī qiángzhì yuángōng měi tiān chuān gōngzuò fú。
exampleEn: The company forces employees to wear work clothes every day.
cloze: 公司＿＿员工每天穿工作服。

exampleZh: 他用机器切割这块石头。
examplePinyin: Tā yòng jīqì qiēgē zhè kuài shítou。
exampleEn: He uses a machine to cut this stone.

exampleZh: 这个新来的同事很勤快。
examplePinyin: Zhège xīn lái de tóngshì hěn qínkuai。
exampleEn: This new colleague is very hardworking.

en: to ask for instructions; to request guidance
exampleZh: 这件事我得先请示领导。
examplePinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ de xiān qǐngshì lǐngdǎo。
exampleEn: I need to ask my boss for instructions on this matter first.

en: to learn from others' experience; to go on a pilgrimage for scriptures
exampleZh: 他专门去南方向老工人取经。
examplePinyin: Tā zhuānmén qù nánfāng xiàng lǎo gōngrén qǔjīng。
exampleEn: He went specially to the south to learn from experienced workers.
cloze: 他专门去南方向老工人＿＿。

exampleZh: 你没有权限打开这个文件。
examplePinyin: Nǐ méiyǒu quánxiàn dǎkāi zhège wénjiàn。
exampleEn: You don't have permission to open this file.

en: the overall situation; the whole picture
exampleZh: 做决定前要先看全局。
examplePinyin: Zuò juédìng qián yào xiān kàn quánjú。
exampleEn: Before making a decision, you should first look at the whole picture.

exampleZh: 她全身心投入到工作中。
examplePinyin: Tā quánshēnxīn tóurù dào gōngzuò zhōng。
exampleEn: She devoted herself wholeheartedly to her work.

exampleZh: 这份报告缺失了几个重要数据。
examplePinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào quēshīle jǐ gè zhòngyào shùjù。
exampleEn: This report is missing several important figures.
cloze: 这份报告＿＿了几个重要数据。

exampleZh: 请告诉我会议的确切时间。
examplePinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ huìyì de quèqiè shíjiān。
exampleEn: Please tell me the exact time of the meeting.

exampleZh: 店里人手不够，忙不过来。
examplePinyin: Diàn lǐ rénshǒu búgòu， máng búguò lái。
exampleEn: The shop doesn't have enough staff and can't keep up.

exampleZh: 他是经理最合适的人选。
examplePinyin: Tā shì jīnglǐ zuì héshì de rénxuǎn。
exampleEn: He is the most suitable candidate for manager.

en: to appoint; to nominate (to a post)
exampleZh: 公司任命她为新的部门经理。
examplePinyin: Gōngsī rènmìng tā wèi xīn de bùmén jīnglǐ。
exampleEn: The company appointed her as the new department manager.
cloze: 公司＿＿她为新的部门经理。

exampleZh: 他的任期还有一年就结束了。
examplePinyin: Tā de rènqī hái yǒu yì nián jiù jiéshùle。
exampleEn: His term of office ends in one more year.
cloze: 他的＿＿还有一年就结束了。

en: to hold a post; to serve (in a position)
exampleZh: 他在这个学校任职十年了。
examplePinyin: Tā zài zhège xuéxiào rènzhí shí niánle。
exampleEn: He has served at this school for ten years.

exampleZh: 今天的日程排得很满。
examplePinyin: Jīntiān de rìchéng pái de hěn mǎn。
exampleEn: Today's schedule is packed.

exampleZh: 这个会议太冗长了，大家都累了。
examplePinyin: Zhège huìyì tài rǒngchángle， dàjiā dōu lèile。
exampleEn: This meeting is too long-winded; everyone is tired.
cloze: 这个会议太＿＿了，大家都累了。

exampleZh: 会议如期举行，没有推迟。
examplePinyin: Huìyì rúqī jǔxíng， méiyǒu tuīchí。
exampleEn: The meeting was held as scheduled, without delay.

exampleZh: 他几十年如一日，工作一直很认真。
examplePinyin: Tā jǐ shí nián rúyí rì， gōngzuò yìzhí hěn rènzhēn。
exampleEn: For decades he has been the same every day, always working seriously.
cloze: 他几十年＿＿日，工作一直很认真。

exampleZh: 会上讨论了若干重要问题。
examplePinyin: Huì shàng tǎolùnle ruògān zhòngyào wèntí。
exampleEn: Several important issues were discussed at the meeting.

en: without authorization; on one's own initiative
exampleZh: 你不能擅自离开工作岗位。
examplePinyin: Nǐ bù néng shànzì líkāi gōngzuò gǎngwèi。
exampleEn: You cannot leave your post without authorization.

exampleZh: 大家正在商讨明年的计划。
examplePinyin: Dàjiā zhèngzài shāngtǎo míngnián de jìhuà。
exampleEn: Everyone is discussing next year's plan.

en: to consult; to discuss and decide
exampleZh: 这件事我们还要再商议。
examplePinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen hái yào zài shāngyì。
exampleEn: We still need to discuss this matter again.

en: to appreciate; to think highly of
exampleZh: 老板很赏识他的工作能力。
examplePinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn shǎngshí tā de gōngzuò nénglì。
exampleEn: The boss thinks highly of his working ability.

en: to report to a higher level
exampleZh: 这个情况必须马上上报。
examplePinyin: Zhège qíngkuàng bìxū mǎshàng shàngbào。
exampleEn: This situation must be reported to the higher level at once.

en: to take up a post; to start work
exampleZh: 新员工下周正式上岗。
examplePinyin: Xīn yuángōng xià zhōu zhèngshì shànggǎng。
exampleEn: The new employees officially start work next week.

en: to take office; to assume a post
exampleZh: 新经理下个月上任。
examplePinyin: Xīn jīnglǐ xià gè yuè shàngrèn。
exampleEn: The new manager takes office next month.

exampleZh: 我的上司对大家很客气。
examplePinyin: Wǒ de shàngsi duì dàjiā hěn kèqi。
exampleEn: My boss is very polite to everyone.

en: to raise (prices, rates); to transfer upward
exampleZh: 公司决定上调员工的工资。
examplePinyin: Gōngsī juédìng shàngtiáo yuángōng de gōngzī。
exampleEn: The company decided to raise the employees' wages.

en: to try hard to; to manage to
exampleZh: 我们会设法解决这个问题。
examplePinyin: Wǒmen huì shèfǎ jiějué zhège wèntí。
exampleEn: We will try hard to solve this problem.

en: unable to control oneself; against one's will
exampleZh: 工作太忙，很多事身不由己。
examplePinyin: Gōngzuò tài máng， hěn duō shì shēnbùyóujǐ。
exampleEn: Work is so busy that many things are beyond my control.

en: to examine; to censor; to review
exampleZh: 这份材料还要再审查一次。
examplePinyin: Zhè fèn cáiliào hái yào zài shěnchá yí cì。
exampleEn: This material needs to be reviewed once more.

en: to examine and approve; to finalize after review
exampleZh: 计划已经由领导审定。
examplePinyin: Jìhuà yǐjīng yóu lǐngdǎo shěndìng。
exampleEn: The plan has already been approved by the leadership.

exampleZh: 工人们正在生产线上工作。
examplePinyin: Gōngrén men zhèngzài shēngchǎnxiàn shàng gōngzuò。
exampleEn: The workers are working on the production line.

en: to be competent for; to be qualified for; to be up to (a job)
exampleZh: 这份工作很复杂，他能胜任吗？
examplePinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò hěn fùzá， tā néng shèngrèn ma？
exampleEn: This job is complicated; is he up to it?
cloze: 这份工作很复杂，他能＿＿吗？

en: to carry out construction; to build
exampleZh: 前面正在施工，请绕道走。
examplePinyin: Qiánmiàn zhèngzài shīgōng， qǐng rào dào zǒu。
exampleEn: Construction is going on ahead, so please take a detour.

en: to pressure; to put pressure on
exampleZh: 他们想用这种方式给公司施压。
examplePinyin: Tāmen xiǎng yòng zhè zhǒng fāngshì gěi gōngsī shīyā。
exampleEn: They want to pressure the company this way.
cloze: 他们想用这种方式给公司＿＿。

en: to put to use; to display (one's talents or skills)
exampleZh: 年轻人在这里可以施展自己的能力。
examplePinyin: Niánqīng rén zài zhèlǐ kěyǐ shīzhǎn zìjǐ de nénglì。
exampleEn: Young people can put their abilities to use here.
cloze: 年轻人在这里可以＿＿自己的能力。

exampleZh: 他们去农村实地了解情况。
examplePinyin: Tāmen qù nóngcūn shídì liǎojiě qíngkuàng。
exampleEn: They went to the countryside to learn about the situation on the spot.

en: office; firm (of a lawyer, accountant, etc.)
exampleZh: 他在一家律师事务所工作。
examplePinyin: Tā zài yì jiā lǜshī shìwùsuǒ gōngzuò。
exampleEn: He works at a law firm.

exampleZh: 会议的具体事宜由他负责。
examplePinyin: Huìyì de jùtǐ shìyí yóu tā fùzé。
exampleEn: He is in charge of the specific arrangements for the meeting.

en: to try out; to put into trial use
exampleZh: 公司决定试行新的工作时间。
examplePinyin: Gōngsī juédìng shìxíng xīn de gōngzuò shíjiān。
exampleEn: The company decided to try out new working hours.
cloze: 公司决定＿＿新的工作时间。

en: to inspect; to visit (an area or project)
exampleZh: 领导明天来视察我们的工厂。
examplePinyin: Lǐngdǎo míngtiān lái shìchá wǒmen de gōngchǎng。
exampleEn: The leaders are coming to inspect our factory tomorrow.
cloze: 领导明天来＿＿我们的工厂。

exampleZh: 他适时地提出了一个好建议。
examplePinyin: Tā shìshí de tíchūle yí gè hǎo jiànyì。
exampleEn: He made a good suggestion at the right time.
cloze: 他＿＿地提出了一个好建议。
